Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game! The second ODI between Afghanistan and Ireland will be played on Sunday, January 24, 2021. Do join us for that at 1000 local (0600 GMT). Till then, take care and cheers!

Asghar Afghan, Afghanistan skipper, says that he is happy with the team's performance. Credits Gurbaz for his debut hundred. Mentions that he himself played a poor shot. Afghan says that Rashid's innings was the turning point in the match and he took the responsibility on finishing the innings well.

Andy Balbirnie, Irish skipper, says that he is disappointed with the team's performance. Adds that Tucker batted well but it was too much for him. Mentions that they got starts but nobody converted it. Balbirnie says that they lost wickets at regular intervals. Further says they will look to improve in the next game and do well.

Rahmanullah Gurbaz is named the Man of the Match. He is happy on receiving the Man of the Match award. Gurbaz says that that he is very pleased with the his performance. Adds that he was looking to put away the bad balls and he played very well.

Earlier, in the game, Afghanistan posted a huge score on the wicket courtesy, Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Rashid Khan. Gurbaz scored a fine century on debut while Rashid ended it brilliantly. Ireland tried hard with the ball but they will be disappointed with their effort at the start and towards the end. In the end, 287 was enough for Afghanistan.

The batting from Ireland was not so good. They lost their two wickets quickly. Paul Stirling stuck around for a while but did not last long. Yes, Curtis Campher and Lorcan Tucker tried very hard and stitched a wonderful partnership but once Campher fell, it was always going to be difficult. Tucker got to his fifty and with partners running out, he went for the shots and perished and from there, it was always going to be difficult. They would hope to make a strong comeback in the next game.

Afghanistan started brilliantly with the ball. Naveen-ul-Haq picked up the starting two wickets to peg Ireland back and they did not look back. Yes, Ireland did give them a fight in the middle overs but the win for Ireland was always on the cards. Once Campher fell, Afghanistan picked up regular wickets and they have won quite comfortably. Mujeeb had a good game while Nabi and Rashid contributed as well but the pick of the bowlers was Naveen-ul-Haq. Overall, it was a decent bowling performance.

A brilliant performance from Afghanistan! They were brilliant with the ball and they have managed to defend 288. They were the favourites right from the start and they have vindicated that with their performance. Ireland will be gutted with their performance and they will look to perform better in the next game.

Good length ball outside off, Balbirnie pushes it to the third man region for a couple of runs.
Andy Balbirnie comes out to bat.

OUT! LBW! Excellent delivery from Naveen-ul-Haq! He completely deceives Kevin O'Brien with a slower ball. Brilliant stuff from the pace bowler. Slower ball on off and middle, O'Brien looks to flick but misses and gets rapped on the pads. The Afghanistan players go up in an appeal and the umpire, after thinking for a while, raises the finger. O'Brien consults his partner for a review but then decides not to take it.
PLAY AND A MISS! Excellent delivery from Naveen-ul-Haq! Good length ball around off, angling in. O'Brien looks to flick but the ball goes in between his bat and pad to the keeper.
Back of a length ball outside off, O'Brien punches it to cover.
Slower ball on off, Kevin defends it to cover.
WIDE! Good length ball down the leg side, O'Brien looks to flick but misses. Gurbaz does well to dive to his left and collect it. Wided.
Quicker on middle, defended back to the bowler.
Flatter on middle and leg, worked to the deep mid-wicket region for a single.
Flatter on middle, Stirling tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Shorter and outside off, Stirling thrashes it through the cover region for a boundary.
Flatter on off, Stirling blocks it off the back foot.
Loopy ball on middle and leg, Stirling flicks it to mid-wicket.
Who will bowl from the other end? Mujeeb Ur Rahman it is.

An appeal for caught behind but turned down! Good length ball down the leg side, O'Brien looks to flick but seems to have hit the gloves. There is an appeal made for caught behind but the umpire is not interested. 9 runs from the first over.
Back of a length ball on off, O'Brien punches it to cover.
Full ball on middle, Stirling looks to defend but it takes the outside edge and it rolls to third man for a single.
FOUR! Creamed! This flew off the middle of the bat! Good length ball outside off, Stirling punches it through extra cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Bang! Nice way to start the innings! Short ball on middle, Stirling rocks on his back foot and then pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary.
Naveen starts with a full delivery on off, Stirling pushes it to mid off.
